newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela sets 60 bln bolivar TEM bill auction.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela sets 60 bln bolivar TEM bill auction.

text.p: The Central Bank of Venezuela on Tuesday morning will hold a 60-billion-bolivar auction of 177-day, 269-day and 358-day "monetary stabilization," or TEM, bills at nominal interest rates of up to 22.54 percent, the bank said on Monday.

The bank said it would offer 40 billion bolivars worth of 177-day bills with a nominal interest rate of 21.39 percent, 10 billion bolivars of 269-day bills at 21.97 percent and 10 billion bolivars of 358-day bills at 22.54 percent.
The Central Bank generally holds its weekly auction of TEM bills each Wednesday. The Bank gave no explanation for bringing the date of the auction forward.
At its auction last week, the central bank sold 140 billion bolivars worth of 178-day, 268-day and 359-day bills with yields of 21.40, 23.69 and 24.88 percent respectively.
